Alpha 1.62.1 (more resilient character downloads)

Browser asset caching should help your character load, not stop an available model from reaching you.

  • Keep available models loading: unavailable browser cache reads fall back to the normal download. Cache quota or write failures no longer produce unhandled errors after a successful asset download.
  • Recover brief network interruptions: a rejected asset GET receives one bounded retry inside the worker before failing. Persistent network failures and HTTP errors remain visible; cancelled requests and non-GET actions are never replayed.
  • Keep your character: authored bodies, fitted gear, Ilyra's permanent wizard outfit and all gameplay rules are unchanged. No account reset, wager or currency changes. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.62.0 (clearer blackjack hands and next wagers)

Prepare your next stake while watching a shared hand, with clear saved payouts and reliable chair turnover.

  • Prepare the next wager: wager controls remain visible while the hand plays. Changing Next wager never changes your confirmed stake or automatically places another bet; the next betting window still requires your click. Hit, Stand, Split and Double stay ahead of those controls on phones.
  • Reliable timeout seating: a 30-second decision timeout stands the current hand and releases its current funded chair only after saving the transition. Reconnected players in that chair remain its owners; a different seat or later patron cannot be ejected by an old timeout. Saved release retries preserve accepted wagers and ordinary settlement.
  • Know your result: natural blackjack remains 3:2 profit, an ordinary win 1:1, and a push returns the stake. Results show pending return until payout is saved. A departed participant's earlier hand is labeled separately from a new chair occupant; the dealer's hidden card stays private.
  • Keep your currency: public tables wager and return Gold; VIP tables wager and return only EP. Limits remain 100,000 Gold or 100 EP. No odds, payout amounts, account reset, automatic wagers or Gold/EP conversion changes. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.61.0 (a seamless Lanternhold Casino visit)

More reliable door and floor interactions in the shared casino, with explicit entry and clear VIP access.

  • Enter on your terms: click the Lanternhold Casino door, walk to it and confirm Enter Casino. Arriving never sends an automatic entry request. Old door buttons and queued walks are retired when your character, connection or scene changes.
  • A clear VIP guard: non-VIP guests still see “You must be a VIP to enter,” but the upstairs button is now disabled. Expired access and changed floors cannot reuse an old confirmation. The server remains responsible for every entry and VIP check.
  • Keep the complete venue: both separate full-size floors retain 46 stations each: four blackjack, four Hold’em, two roulette, four baccarat and 32 slot machines. The shared arrival, Lanternhold Casino signage, stash clearance, visible seated patrons and physical table views remain in place.
  • Clean transitions: accepted floor changes close the door dialogue; retired casino controls cannot send after disposal. Leaving a table restores normal camera and movement controls. Current-session door confirmations still require one click.
  • Scope and continuity: No station removal, wallet conversion, wager, payout, monthly EP or account reset change. Public tables use Gold; VIP tables use EP. EP remains cosmetic-only and cannot return to Gold. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.60.0 (companions, clear rewards and your next adventure)

Connect guild plans to real-player recruitment and make boss rewards explain what is complete, what remains and where to go next.

  • From calendar to companions: a current guild event can open Groups for its activity. No listing, invitation, sign-up or party membership is created automatically. Listings last 20 minutes; longer-term plans stay in the calendar. Changed, cancelled, finished or unsupported events, guild departure and old session controls cannot reuse a stale handoff.
  • A boss is not always the finale: intermediate boss summaries show run progress. Only the server-confirmed final guardian reports a completed dungeon or Dark King raid. An elemental guardian kill instead points you to Maelin and all three crystal-repair Vigil waves.
  • Actual earned progression: boss and room reward messages retain their XP/Resonance receipt, including a reward that crosses level 100. Reward text no longer loses the split in transport; no reward amount or recipient rule changes.
  • Your next adventure remains a choice: recover in town and Continue at the latest cleared boss checkpoint, personally claim ready story chapters with Ilyra, or use the Dungeon Guide to prepare another activity or help a group. Weekly cache settlement is separate; another clear cannot grant another weekly cache. Optional endgame goals, seasons and world events remain optional.
  • Connected social checks: real-socket recruitment retains private applications, explicit invitation acceptance, ready checks and normal session resume without changing Gold, EP or progression. The existing CI job retains this exercise; no extra matchmaking queue or long campaign test was added.
  • Scope and continuity: No account reset, balance change, forced chores, season reset or closed-beta transition. Human population, pacing and physical-phone party/dungeon observations remain separate acceptance work. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.59.0 (player safety and accountable moderation)

  • Player safety: Select a chat sender to Block and Ignore or draft a conduct report. Only the selected message is included, and submission always needs your approval.
  • Accountable decisions: Temporary chat mutes, required public name corrections and temporary suspensions require a verified administrator, an explicit account and case, private staff evidence, a public explanation and separate confirmation. Each response is independently reversible and audited.
  • Help stays available: Account help on the login screen lets authenticated players read their notices, correct a required public name or submit an appeal without entering the world. Suspensions and name requirements stop active play and re-entry; a chat mute only restricts chat.
  • Names without lost progress: Public names update in the world and social, auction and PvP displays. Invitations and whispers accept public names; quote names with spaces, for example /w "Moon Keeper" hello. Login identity, saves, friendships, guild ownership, Gold and EP remain unchanged, and renaming cannot bypass existing blocks.
  • Private case follow-up: Players can check their own submitted report status. Administrators can filter and explicitly resolve or reopen cases. Appeals do not automatically reverse decisions; private staff evidence is not shown to players.
  • Progress preserved: No account reset, balance, rewards, currency conversion, asset or public-alpha access changes. No automatic punishments, new staff role or evidence purge. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.58.5 (Ilyra returns in full regalia)

  • A proper archmage: Ilyra wears indigo robes, a plum mantle, aged-gold trim and a circlet, with four elemental stones and a crystal-tipped staff.
  • Clothes stay on: This is a permanent NPC outfit for town and story projections. Player Wizards retain their own models and equipped gear; empty NPC equipment cannot strip Ilyra.
  • Reliable presence: Independent idle animation, a dressed procedural fallback on loading failure, and the gold story quest marker remain intact.
  • Progress preserved: No account reset, combat, quest, class-rule, reward or currency changes. No unfinished moderation features are included. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.58.4 (clear equipment types)

  • Know your gear: Armor shows Cloth, Leather or Plate; weapons show Sword, Dagger, Mace or Staff. Shields and tomes show their own type. Unknown legacy gear keeps a generic label rather than an invented material.
  • Class restrictions at a glance: The type appears red when your class cannot equip the item, with a short text warning too. Existing class rules determine eligibility.
  • Consistent inspection: Type information appears in hover and eligible equipped comparison tooltips, and in desktop and phone item-details dialogs.
  • Progress preserved: No class rules, stats, combat, rewards, currencies or model files changed. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.58.3 (lighter equipped heroes)

  • Balanced release checks: Interface checks now share the existing three GitHub-hosted CI jobs, with whole-file suites preserved and every case scheduled exactly once. No test coverage or release gate was removed.
  • Less rendering work: Compatible opaque fitted armor shares draw calls while preserving the supplied models, materials, animated surfaces and independent skeletons. The controlled equipped crowd used about 18–20% fewer draw calls; this is not a universal FPS promise.
  • Stealth stays clear: Rogues temporarily use the original individual transparent pieces during stealth, then restore the opaque batches. Textured, transparent and custom-shader pieces stay separate.
  • Honest Low detail: Saved Low graphics and mobile actor loading use the delivered Low bodies. Changing detail offers an optional reload when existing bodies do not match; lighting and effects still change immediately. Medium retains High bodies on desktop.
  • Existing progress preserved: No account reset, combat, class rules, reward or currency changes. Broad performance and physical-phone checks remain separate. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.58.2 (fitted heroes and dual-wield Rogues)

  • Your new heroes: Fighter, Rogue, Wizard and Cleric now use the delivered rigged character models at High and Low quality, with independent skeletons and a procedural fallback if a model cannot load.
  • Gear that fits: All 36 base wearable items select the matching class fit or calibrated weapon grip from the 252-model collection. Standard and Legendary variants, paired rings and trinkets, covered skin and hair, mixed outfits, and robe/skirt layering are supported. Equipment loads on demand and does not change another player's model.
  • Class equipment rules: Wizards wear cloth; Rogues wear cloth or leather; Fighters and Clerics can wear every armor type. Rogues cannot use staves or equip shields/tomes offhand. Fighters and Clerics may use every weapon. Invalid saved gear stays recoverable in your bag controls and grants no stats while inactive.
  • Two weapons, faster strikes: Rogues with two valid weapons use two-thirds of their normal basic-attack interval and alternate main-hand and offhand attack motions. This speeds the existing single-hit attack; it does not create two damage events. Inspect a weapon and choose Equip offhand, or drag it to that slot. Weapon-specific idle, movement, block and attack motions follow your equipped gear.
  • Hits match the motion: Reviewed weapon attacks, including both Rogue hands, reach their visible contact pose at the existing basic-attack damage point. Damage timing and amounts are unchanged.
  • Existing progress preserved: No account reset, currency grants, loot-rate or campaign changes. The level-up and Well Rested polish from 1.58.1 remains. Final art approval, crowd performance and physical-phone dungeon checks remain separate work. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.58.1 (brighter celebrations and sanctuary light)

  • A level worth celebrating: Level-ups send gold and elemental sparks spiraling upward through a soft light column, with an expanding ground pulse. The effect follows your character instead of staying behind when you move.
  • A richer Well Rested aura: Soft star-shaped motes rise above layered golden filigree with Earth, Air, Fire and Water accents. The aura stays open around the character rather than forming a solid enclosure.
  • Readable at gameplay zoom: Spark sizing follows the actual camera projection and drawing-buffer size. Low quality uses fewer sparks; reduced motion removes spinning beams, orbital movement and expanding pulses. Celebrations retire their effects after three seconds.
  • Presentation only: Healing, Well Rested power and duration, XP, rewards, currencies, character saves and open-alpha access are unchanged. This patch does not include new Rogue, Cleric or Wizard models; those swaps await the supplied exports. Full prior patch history remains below.
